# rms_device (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a single Teltonika RMS Device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_device" "main" {
  id = 1
}

output "device_serial" {
  value = data.rms_device.main.serial
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The device ID.

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `device_series` (String) The device series.
- `firmware` (String) The firmware version.
- `imei` (String) The IMEI number.
- `mac` (String) The MAC address.
- `name` (String) The device name.
- `serial` (String) The device serial number.
- `status` (String) The device status.
